warningLines: Horns on the west wind — riders under a pale moon. To the walls! They come in {count} heartbeats of {seconds}.
Dust on the west road and a horn through the pines. {count} raiders, {seconds} breaths out. Light the lamps.
The watchfire gutters — hoofbeats past the treeline. {count} coming, {seconds} to bar the doors.
attackLines: They are over the fence! Wave {wave}, {count} strong — stand together!
victoryLines: The bell rings long — the Manner stands. {kills} fell, their pouches ours (+{loot} gold). Mend what broke.
Quiet again. {kills} raiders down, +{loot} gold in salvage. Oil the hinges and reset the traps.
defeatLines: The hall is ash and the bell is silent. Take the salvage wood and raise the beams again at dawn.
They broke the manor and melted into the trees. Salvage what you can — the village rises again.
